contract.atomicFactSet: exact current已确认Custom Target Intent/Preview + 原始标准完整Spec + 当前跨Owner公开投影的opaque read fence + Run/Scope/identity/material与目标head验证 + 新custom Spec与Subject Decision Head CAS + Command Receipt/marker/Audit；幂等重放返回同一Spec，不能重新分配revision。只写Libra Spec/decision head及Foundation技术回执，不建立Run、不旁读Arca/Perception表、不改原Spec或旧失败；`hasOutbox=false`
